query:
SELECT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM users u
               WHERE u.id = $1
                 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM banned_users b WHERE b.user_id = u.id)
                 AND EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM refresh_tokens t
                     WHERE t.family_id = $2 AND t.user_id = u.id AND t.revoked_at IS NULL
                 )
           ) AS "is_active!"
